prompt: Screenshot from a Nioh test rig, 1280x720. Answer every question about this frame only.
screen_instructions: Classify the current Nioh screen with exactly one choice.
highlight_instructions: Which menu item or map node is currently highlighted/selected by the cursor?

screens.description: Title screen menu: NEW GAME / CONTINUE / LOAD GAME / SYSTEM.
Boot notice, logo, "press any button", or a black/loading screen with only a spinner.
Full-screen artwork with a paragraph of tip/lore text and a CONTINUE prompt bottom right.
The world map with region name top-left; no menu panel open.
World map with a left menu panel: Shrine, Blacksmith, Dojo, Torii Gate, Hidden Teahouse, Storehouse.
Torii Gate menu: Yokai Realm with a Companion / Random Encounters / Battle.
"Yokai Realm with a Companion" panel: With Conditions row, a mission box, Difficulty, Friends and Secret Word rows, and a Search button. No popup over it.
A "Searching for a companion..." popup with a CANCEL button, or another matchmaking wait.

Companion preparation menu: Cancel or Preparations complete / Choose mission / Starting point / Companion information on the left, a waiting or preparations banner at the top, and a Companion name at the bottom right.
In-mission pause menu: a row of round icon tabs top-left with a tab title such as EQUIPMENT, ITEMS or SYSTEM and the mission name below; no list open.
USABLE ITEMS list on the left with an item description panel in the middle.
A small USE / SET AS SHORTCUT popup over the item list.
A result summary such as "Yokai Realm with a Companion: Failed" or mission complete, with a CONTINUE prompt at the bottom.
A yes/no or confirmation dialog box over the game (not the searching popup).
Third-person gameplay in a mission with health bars top-left, no menu open.

highlights.description: CONTINUE on the title menu
Title menu: NEW GAME
Title menu: LOAD GAME or SYSTEM
World map: the selected node is the shrine-like STARTING POINT (label STARTING POINT shown above the highlighted node)
World map: a mission or other node is selected (a mission info panel on the right, or a label other than STARTING POINT)
Map menu: Shrine
Map menu: Torii Gate
Map menu: Blacksmith, Dojo, Hidden Teahouse or Storehouse
Torii menu: Random Encounters or Battle
Torii menu: Yokai Realm with a Companion
Companion panel: the top row is selected - a pale blue bar behind the words "With Conditions" and bright white < > arrows around its value; no glowing frame on any box
Companion panel: the Search button has a glowing blue frame (hint box reads "Begin search.")
Companion panel: the mission box, Friends or Secret Word row has the glowing frame or blue bar
Information dialog with a single CONFIRM/OK button highlighted
Yes/No dialog: YES highlighted
Yes/No dialog: NO highlighted
Pause ring: the ITEMS tab is selected (title reads ITEMS)
Pause ring: a tab other than ITEMS is selected
Item list: Himorogi Fragment is highlighted
Item list: another item is highlighted
Item popup: USE is highlighted
Companion preparation menu: Starting point is highlighted
No menu cursor visible

without_conditions.instructions: Companion panel only: does the value on the right of the top row read exactly "Without Conditions"?

coop_partner.instructions: Is another player character (gold-outlined visitor, or a name plate like Nioh-LAN-A/B/C) visible or listed in the party HUD at top-left?
